children: The Canadian dollar weakened against the greenback on Tuesday, and the yield on benchmark government debt climbed.
was trading 0.2% lower at C$1.3883 to the greenback, or 72.03 U.S. cents, after trading in a range of 1.3846 to 1.3888.
Canadian government 10-year bond yields (CA10YT=RR) rose 2.4 basis points to 3.763%. The yield on similar U.S. government benchmark debt rose to 4.78%.
futures rose $2.31 to $88.07 a barrel on Tuesday.
